title: Descent of individual fixed-orbit components
statement: Let R,H be commutative rings, ι:R→H a ring map, g∈R, and C a domain H-algebra finite and faithfully flat over H. Put h=algebraMap H C (ι(g)) and assume h≠0. A finite group G acts by H-algebra maps ρ satisfying the identity and multiplication laws. Assume D(h)→Spec H is étale and any two field-valued points of C over H, on which h is nonzero, differ by a unique element of G. Let p:Y→Spec R factor as a finite étale map j:Y→D(g). Given t:T→Spec R, k:D(h)→T over Spec R, and an isomorphism δ:Y×T≅∐(Fin d) T over T, let A be the induced label action defined by [lem-sbc-affine-torsor-split-label-laws]. Suppose r:Fin m→Fin d meets every A-orbit exactly once, and K:Fin m→Subgroup G gives its exact stabilizers. Put F_i=intersection over ζ∈K_i of the equalizers of ρ(ζ) and identity in C. Then Y×Spec H is isomorphic over Spec H to the coproduct over Fin m of D(algebraMap H F_i (ι(g))) in Spec F_i.

source.place: Tag 03SF, Galois covers of connected schemes; Tag 0EYG, fixed-subalgebra construction

proof.text: Apply the single-stabilizer-component theorem to each r(i) and K(i). Choose the resulting maps f_i with their open-immersion proofs, base projection equations, and pullback-section equations. This uses only the exact stabilizers, not completeness or distinctness.
Apply the representative-component-cover theorem to these actual maps f_i. Completeness gives supremum opensRange equal to top and distinctness gives pairwise disjointness.

Mathlib nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of gives a colimit cofan for the disjoint open cover. Cofan.nonempty_isColimit_iff_isIso_sigmaDesc gives IsIso(Sigma.desc f). Take the inverse of asIso(Sigma.desc f). Sigma.hom_ext and Sigma.ι_desc prove Sigma.desc f followed by the pullback projection is Sigma.desc of the component structural maps. Compose this equality with the inverse; IsIso.inv_hom_id and Category.id_comp give the required structural-map equation. The argument includes the empty family without a case split.
